questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Naturen, kulturen, universitetet, engelsk som første sprog, i Europa.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg synes virkelig, at jeg havde et godt ophold. Der er kun en ting, som jeg synes, at man skal være opmærksom på, og det er, at folk i Edinburgh starter studie ret tidligt, så jeg var ofte en del ældre, men jeg formåede at finde folk på ældre årgange. Herudover savnede jeg lidt sol og varme nogle gange.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Ja, det synes jeg. Generelt er det lidt overvældende at tage på udveksling, men det er worth it.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik hele tiden emails fra universitetet med informationer både omkring Welcome Week, studiestart, kursusændringer osv.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Jeg søgte om accommodation gennem universitetet. Jeg fik ikke en af de 5 boliger, som jeg prioriterede, men stedet jeg fik tildelt var okay. Det var Riego Street.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Der var et fælleskøkken i min lejlighed. Vær obs. på, at alt service skal købes eller medbringes selv. Jeg var overrasket over, at jeg skulle bruge en del penge på det, og ked af hvilket spild det var.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Det er lidt dyrt, men jeg er glad for, at jeg boede on campus, da jeg lærte en del andre udvekslingsstuderende igennem det. Mange udvekslingsstuderende bor på Riego Street. Jeg vil klart anbefale at bo i kollegie eller med roomies, da man her får tildelt et naturligt netværk.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg fik som sagt ikke en af mine 5 prioriterede ønsker, men jeg fik tildelt noget, og det var jeg lykkelig over.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Ingen problemer der.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man får en email fra ens studievejleder, og den skal man bare følge.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kunne skrive til ens tildelte studievejleder, som svarede hurtigt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det gik okay. Jeg skulle skifte et fag ud, da det clashede med et af mindre andre, men det gik fint, da jeg gjorde det hurtigt i mit ophold.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Vær i god tid, check emails og brug hjemmesiden path til at tjekke overlap af kurser.
Link her:
https://path.is.ed.ac.uk/

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg var glad for mine kurser, men jeg synes niveauet var lidt lavt nogle gange, men for at være ærlig var det helt perfekt, da kulturen, venner osv. bare kom til at fylde mere.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: SCQF Level 10 (Year 3 Undergraduate)

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Undervisningen på University of Edinburgh er generelt mere interaktiv. Det skal man nok lige være obs. på.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Race and Ethnicity, Sociology of Emotions, Statistical Modelling

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Race and Ethnicity! Katucha Bento er den sejeste underviser. Har lært så meget af hende!

questions.answer: Min mobil gik i stykker på et tidspunkt, og så alt det køkkenudstyr man skulle købe.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Køkkenting

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Synes virkelig, jeg var positiv overrasket over alle deres societies. Jeg var en del af mountaineering og blue tits. Kan klart anbefale at blive en del af societies, da man her kan finde folk med samme interesser og venner.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Så mange. De har en hel hjemmeside med alle societiesene.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg kunne godt lide mountaineering og blue tits. Især mountaineering er socialt.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Se naturen! Tag på hikes. Besøg Glasgow. Ps de fleste museer er gratis!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Jeg fandt mig hurtigt til rette. Folk er søde, åbne og byen minder okay meget om kbh.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Bliv en del af societies og vær ikke bange for at snakke med andre studerende under Welcome Week.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Savnede så meget at cykle, men ellers ikke meget.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Venlighed, pubkultur, humor, societies

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Husk det hele skal nok gå, køb vacumtasker til at pakke dine kufferter, oplev naturen

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Skift kurser tidligt, hvis de overlapper.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Mine nye venskaber, udvikling, bedre engelsk kundskaber

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Nogle gange kan det være lidt ensomt, men husk det er en del af oplevelsen.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Nyd det! Tiden flyver afsted!

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
